mood: Sharp and rhythmic: glowing lanes, a laser slash and music you can see.

shape.borderStyle: 1px solid cyan at 60% with a soft glow

buttonStyle: Primary is a cyan neon-outline button with white Audiowide text that fills pink-to-cyan on hover; secondary is a dark button with a pink hairline.
backdrop: Navy gradient with a perspective runway whose lane lines scroll toward the viewer slowly, and two rows of equalizer bars gently easing in height (opacity/transform, under 1 Hz).
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
